versions.changelog:
qc-data-processor 1.0.2

- Updated mcp_server.py (details of code changes not described).
- No changes to documentation or user-facing API.
- Version bump only; behavior and feature set unchanged.

- Added full Simplified Chinese translations alongside all English content in documentation.
- Clarified usage scenarios, tool descriptions, and examples with bilingual (English/Chinese) text.
- Expanded and translated key points under "When to Use," "Trigger Keywords," and tool usage.
- Updated description to include both English and Chinese for greater accessibility.

Initial release of QC Data Processor — an MCP server for automated quality control data analysis and reporting.

- Supports QC data parsing, SPC (control charts, Cp/Cpk), and reliability (Weibull/Lognormal) analysis.
- Generates Markdown-formatted QC reports (daily, weekly, 8D, reliability).
- Tools for: data parsing, SPC analysis, reliability fitting, and report generation.
- Accepts Excel/CSV inputs; outputs text/JSON results.
- Designed for manufacturing quality control workflows.
